title: 2023 SVB & Regional Bank Crisis
storyline: A year of whiplash: a strong start, a sudden US regional-bank crisis in March, an AI-led equity rally, a bond rout that takes the 10-year yield to 5%, and a Fed pivot in December. China's reopening disappoints throughout.

regime.name: Peak rates?
regime.description: Inflation is falling but the Fed is still hiking. Investors hope for a soft landing; banks sit on large unrealised bond losses.

events.headline: US payrolls surge by 517k; yields jump
events.altHeadline: US payrolls blow past forecasts; yields jump

events.headline: Powell: rates likely to go higher than previously expected
events.altHeadline: Fed chair: rates are likely to go higher than previously expected
events.body: He opened the door to returning to larger hikes.

events.headline: Silicon Valley Bank collapses, the biggest US bank failure since 2008
events.altHeadline: A US tech-focused lender collapses after a deposit run, the biggest failure in 15 years
events.body: It was forced to sell bonds at a loss to meet withdrawals.

events.headline: Regulators guarantee all SVB deposits; Fed launches emergency lending programme
events.altHeadline: Regulators guarantee all deposits at the failed lender; Fed launches emergency lending
events.body: Two-year Treasury yields had their biggest fall since 1987.

events.headline: UBS to buy Credit Suisse for $3bn; AT1 bondholders wiped out
events.altHeadline: Swiss banking giant takes over its stricken rival; risky bank bonds wiped out
events.body: The write-down of $17bn of AT1 bonds shocked credit investors across Asia.

events.headline: Fed hikes 25bp and hints the end is near
events.altHeadline: Fed hikes 25bp and hints the end of the cycle is near
events.body: The statement dropped its reference to "ongoing increases".

events.headline: First Republic seized and sold to JPMorgan
events.altHeadline: A third US regional bank is seized and sold to the country's largest lender
events.body: Regional bank shares remain under pressure.

events.headline: White House and Republicans reach debt-ceiling deal
events.altHeadline: US leaders reach a deal to raise the debt ceiling
events.body: The agreement averts a default days before the deadline.

events.headline: Fitch strips the United States of its AAA rating
events.altHeadline: A rating agency strips the United States of its top credit rating
events.body: It cited fiscal deterioration and repeated debt-limit standoffs.

events.headline: Country Garden misses bond payments; Evergrande files for US bankruptcy protection
events.altHeadline: China's largest private developer misses bond payments
events.body: New-home sales have fallen for 26 months.

events.headline: Hamas attacks Israel; oil jumps on fears of wider conflict
events.altHeadline: War erupts in the Middle East; oil jumps on fears of a wider conflict
events.body: Gold and the dollar also rose.

events.headline: US 10-year yield hits 5% for the first time since 2007
events.altHeadline: US 10-year yield hits 5% for the first time in 16 years
events.body: Heavy Treasury issuance and strong data are pushing long rates up.

events.headline: US inflation flat in October; rate-hike bets collapse
events.altHeadline: US consumer prices flat on the month; rate-hike bets collapse
events.body: Small caps and long bonds led a broad rally.

events.headline: Fed pivots: holds rates and signals three cuts in 2024
events.altHeadline: Fed pivots: holds rates and signals three cuts next year
events.body: The chair said cuts were discussed at the meeting.
